properties.description: An override for the name of the generated python package.

properties.description: Python package requirements to add to the generated package's metadata, as a map from distribution name to version specifier.

properties.description: Toggle compatibility mode for a specified target.
properties.name: compatibility

properties.description: This bool is no longer needed since all providers now use input/output classes.

properties.description: Determines whether to make single-return-value methods return an output object or the single value.
properties.name: liftSingleValueMethodReturns

properties.description: Respect the Pkg.Version field for emitted code.

properties.description: If enabled, a pyproject.toml file will be generated.
properties.name: pyproject

properties.description:
Specifies what types are used for inputs. Allowed values are the following:

- "classes": Args classes only
- "classes-and-dicts" (default): TypedDicts side-by-side with Args classes.
properties.name: inputTypes

properties.description: Whether the property name is mapped between the schema's camelCase and Python's snake_case. Defaults to true.
properties.name: mapCase
